description: This file is an Android activity class named DateWidgets2, which demonstrates the use of TimePicker widget and date/time display.

classes.name: DateWidgets2
classes.description: An Android Activity that sets up a TimePicker widget and displays the selected time in a TextView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, configures the TimePicker, and defines the behavior when the time is changed.

methods.name: updateDisplay
methods.description: Updates the TextView with the current time formatted as HH:MM.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Helper method that formats an integer into a two-digit string, adding a leading zero if necessary.
